description: MCP server for the Xendit payment API. Invoices, disbursements, balances, and transactions across Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam, and Malaysia.

tool_signatures.name: Xendit
tool_signatures.description: Payment infrastructure for Southeast Asia. This MCP uses Payment Links via /v2/invoices and payouts via /v2/payouts.

tool_signatures.name: cancel_disbursement
tool_signatures.description: Cancel a prepared disbursement before it is confirmed. Idempotent when the token is already gone.

tool_signatures.name: confirm_disbursement
tool_signatures.description: Execute a previously prepared disbursement token by creating a payout in Xendit. Requires a separate human approval code.

approvalCode.description: Human approval code from XENDIT_APPROVAL_CODE. Do not expose it to untrusted prompt context.

parameters.name: approvalCode
parameters.description: Human approval code from XENDIT_APPROVAL_CODE. Do not expose it to untrusted prompt context.

tool_signatures.name: create_disbursement
tool_signatures.description: [DEPRECATED — prefer prepare_disbursement + confirm_disbursement] Send money to a payout channel in a single call. Requires an approval code and explicit legacy opt-in.

bankCode.description: Payout channel code (for example ID_BCA) or legacy bank alias (for example BCA).

accountHolderName.description: Recipient name as registered with the bank or wallet

accountNumber.description: Recipient account number or mobile number

approvalCode.description: Human approval code from XENDIT_APPROVAL_CODE. Keep it out of model-visible untrusted context.

tool_signatures.description: Create a new payment invoice. Returns a payment link your customer can use to pay.

customerGivenNames.description: Customer first/given names for the hosted payment page.

customerMobileNumber.description: Customer mobile number in E.164 format, for example +6287774441111.

invoiceDuration.description: Invoice expiry duration in seconds (default: 86400 = 24 hours)
